name: Topologically Defined Isosurface via Connectedness Couples
definition: A valid connectedness couple is a pair (alpha, lambda) where alpha is the foreground connectivity and lambda is the background connectivity. Valid couples are (26, 6), (18, 6), (6, 26), and (6, 18).
summary: This method extracts a topologically correct isosurface from binary volumes by enforcing valid connectedness couples, ensuring a closed 2-manifold without singularities.
